name: BR 140
manufacturer: Krauss-Maffei, Krupp, Henschel, Siemems, AEG, BBC
description: The Baureihe E 40 is a German Standard electric locomotive (German: Einheits-Elektrolokomotive) commissioned by the Deutsche Bundesbahn in 1955, designed for freight trains. Since the 1968 renumbering, it is listed as Class 140 and Class 139.
